paper_title: 基于框架语义映射和类型感知的篇章事件抽取*
caption: DuEE-fin训练集各事件类型分布
model_annotation: The bar chart displays the distribution of event types in the DuEE-fin training set. The horizontal axis lists 14 event types, in a specific order, without clear indication of how they are sorted, and the vertical axis represents the frequency of event types, with values ranging from 0 to 1400, marked at intervals of 200. Each event type is represented by a blue bar. The longest bar, representing "股份回购" (share buyback), has a value of approximately 1300. The shortest bar, representing "被纠纠" (being糾糾), has a value of approximately 200. Other notable bars include "仲裁" (arbitration) with a value of around 1100, and "质押" (pledge) and "企业收购" (enterprise acquisition), both with values slightly below 1000. The remaining bars have values ranging from approximately 900 to 300. There is no visual emphasis on any of the bars.
